title: Run Your Rules
briefing: Meadow Pharma offers the same setup three times: a pullback in an uptrend. Use the same rule each time, with the same stop, and judge the results together.
objective: Practice testing an edge: repeat one rule with fixed risk, record every result, and judge many trades, not one.
debrief: Meadow Pharma pulled back three times: on day 6, day 16 and day 26. In most runs the first two pullbacks recovered and the third, after the trial delay, kept falling into the stop. Using the same rule with the same stop kept each loss small. Three trades cannot prove an edge; only a journal of many trades across many matches can show whether the rule really pays.
